data.desc: Mueller Industries, Inc. (NYSE: MLI) is a global industrial corporation whose holdings are leading manufacturers and distributors of essential products. Those products support our critical infrastructure and serve a broad range of industries including plumbing, heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration (HVACR), industrial manufacturing, appliance, transportation, medical, military and defense and electrical. In addition to being the only vertically integrated manufacturer of copper tube and fittings, brass rod and forgings in North America ; the Company also has operations in Europe , Asia and the Middle East.
